name: China Railway Special Cargo Logistics Co., Ltd.
summary: China Railway Special Cargo Logistics Co., Ltd. (CRSCL) is a prominent enterprise based in Beijing, China, specializing in comprehensive rail freight and logistics services throughout the country. The company's operations are strategically structured into three core divisions: Commodity Automobile Logistics, Cold Chain Logistics, and Bulk Cargo Logistics. This allows CRSCL to adeptly manage the secure and efficient transport of a wide variety of goods. Their extensive portfolio includes everything from new commercial vehicles and temperature-sensitive refrigerated products to exceptionally large and heavy industrial components like transformers, generator stators and rotors, and boiler drums. Furthermore, they handle specialized construction materials such as arches, prefabricated beams, long rails, and miscellaneous machinery parts. CRSCL commenced its operations in 2003.
